description: Change an existing list's name, geo (country with region/city/isp/zip, or countries), rotation or format; omitted fields keep their values. The login stays the same. The IP whitelist (network) cannot be changed: delete the list and create a new one for that.

city.description: Only valid with a single country (names from get_geo).

countries.description: 2-30 ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Mutually exclusive with country/subfilters.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, any case. Mutually exclusive with countries.

format.description: Saved export-format preference for the dashboard. Does not change entries in the response.

isp.description: Only valid with a single country (names from get_geo).

proxy_id.description: prx_... id of an active shared proxy

region.description: Only valid with a single country (names from get_geo).

rotation_mode.description: What happens when the current node fails

rotation_period_seconds.description: 0=new IP per request, -1=sticky, N=keep the IP for N seconds (max 86400)

zip.description: Only valid with a single country.

name: update_proxy_list
title: Update proxy list
